icon.prompt: Create one polished mobile puzzle game app icon for a game called Sand Slice, with NO text, NO letters, NO numbers. Square 1:1 composition. A large satisfying cube of kinetic sand with vivid layered rainbow stripes (purple, blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange and coral), a clean diagonal slice separating a small section, soft individual grain texture and rounded beveled edges. A small shiny white cutting spatula makes the slice, readable silhouette. Playful premium casual game 3D rendering, candy-colored coral-pink backdrop, subtle purple shadow, bright soft studio lighting. Rounded-square app tile filling the image, bold central composition, generous safe padding for small-size recognition. No logos or watermark. This is a new replacement app icon for the user's local game project.
